title: STRIDE: spoofing, tampering, repudiation, information disclosure, denial of service and elevation of privilege

videos.script: Ask a room what can go wrong with a system and you get a list. It is a list of what the room happened to think of. Injection, because everybody has heard of it. Passwords, because somebody was phished last month. {{room}} The next person asks: what did we miss? Nobody knows, because the list had no shape. {{shape}} STRIDE gives it one. Six words, and each is the opposite of something you want. Spoofing breaks who you think you are talking to. Tampering breaks what you think the data says. {{six}} Then you walk the drawing. Every element, every flow that crosses a line. For each one, you ask the six questions that apply to it. {{walk}} Today you do that for the clinic portal and find fourteen threats. Then a tool finds a hundred and ninety-six, and you learn why the fourteen are the ones that matter. {{tool}}
